description: This sweet West Olympia home includes a separate buildable lot behind.  Endless possibilities to build a shop with ADU, your dream landscape, or even another home. This spacious and updated 3-bed/3-bath home offers exceptional flexibility with 1,876 sq ft, a main-floor bedroom with access to full bath, and both a main-level living room as well as an upper family room—perfect for multi-use living. Living and dining with fireplace on main floor, kitchen with tile flooring and Maple cabinets, ample office with built in desks off kitchen ideal for working from home.  Huge primary suite and luxury private bath as well as 3rd bedroom with access to full bath on upper floor.   Recent updates; new roof, exterior paint, new carpet, interior paint, new appliances, enhance comfort and reduce maintenance. A covered patio provides sheltered outdoor space ideal for Pacific Northwest weather, and the attached garage adds storage and convenience. Located near Trader Joe’s, Capital Mall, Garfield Nature Trail, and quick routes to downtown Olympia, this home sits in a desirable, established neighborhood known for walkability, mature trees, and strong community amenities.
